title: 印度被贴反AI标签：贝莱德却说并不成立，那1200人招聘又说明什么？
speaker: Egon Vavric

segments.en: One of the longer-term implications of AI for market like India, there's this narrative that it could upend when it comes to technological technology and services and what we're seeing there that AI can really disrupt that part of the economy very substantially.
segments.zh: AI对印度这类市场的长期影响之一，是有一种说法认为它可能颠覆科技与服务板块，我们看到AI确实可能对这部分经济造成相当大的扰动。

segments.en: What do you make of that?

For many investor perspective, today India is probably still receiving a labeling of anti-AI exposure which I think we don't have too much, simply I think India has many very interesting fundamental drivers which can carry the markets so I think we still interesting and constructive on the regional long-term.
segments.zh: 从很多投资者的角度看，今天印度可能仍被贴上'反AI'的标签，我们认为这并不太成立。印度有许多非常有意思的基本面驱动因素可以支撑市场，所以我们对这一地区长期仍持建设性看法。
